title: Passive Voice and Reported Speech
ringkas: Pasif di berbagai tenses dan reported speech
goals: membentuk kalimat **pasif** di berbagai tense: [[is/are + V3]], [[was/were + V3]], [[will be + V3]], [[has/have been + V3]]
mengubah kalimat aktif menjadi pasif dan sebaliknya
memakai pasif dengan modal: [[can be + V3]], [[must be + V3]], [[should be + V3]]
memahami **reported speech** (kalimat tidak langsung) dan perubahan tense-nya
mengubah pernyataan, pertanyaan, dan perintah ke reported speech
mengubah keterangan waktu dan tempat: [[today → that day]], [[tomorrow → the next day]], [[here → there]]

lesson.text: Dua cara menyampaikan informasi yang sering muncul di ujian: **passive voice** ketika yang penting adalah *apa yang terjadi* (bukan siapa pelakunya), dan **reported speech** ketika kita menceritakan ulang apa yang dikatakan orang lain.

lesson.title: Rumus mengubah aktif ke pasif
lesson.text: 1) Objek aktif → subjek pasif. 2) Kata kerja → **to be + V3** (to be mengikuti tense). 3) Subjek aktif → **by + pelaku** (boleh dihilangkan jika tidak penting). Contoh: [[Dina wrote the letter.]] → [[The letter was written by Dina.]]

lesson.title: Hanya kata kerja transitif
lesson.text: Pasif hanya untuk kata kerja yang punya **objek** (transitif). Kata kerja seperti [[arrive]], [[sleep]], [[happen]], [[go]] tidak punya bentuk pasif.

lesson.title: 3. Reported speech: pernyataan
table: [[She said (that) she had gone to Bali.]]

lesson.title: 4. Perubahan tense dan kata keterangan
table: the next day / the following day
the day before / the previous day

lesson.title: Pronoun ikut berubah
lesson.text: Sesuaikan juga kata gantinya: [["I like my school," Tom said.]] → [[Tom said (that) he liked his school.]] Jika kalimat pelapor di masa lampau ([[said]]), tense bergeser satu langkah ke belakang.

lesson.title: 5. Reported question dan command
table: [[She told me to close the door.]]
[[He told me not to be late.]]

lesson.title: Urutan kata pada reported question
lesson.text: Pada reported question urutannya seperti **kalimat biasa** (subjek lalu kata kerja), tanpa do/does/did dan tanpa tanda tanya: [[He asked where I lived.]] (bukan *where did I live*).

items: Pasif = **to be (sesuai tense) + V3**; objek aktif jadi subjek pasif.
Pasif modal: [[can/must/should + be + V3]]; present perfect: [[has/have been + V3]].
Reported speech: tense **bergeser ke belakang** ([[am → was]], [[will → would]]).
Keterangan berubah: [[tomorrow → the next day]], [[here → there]], [[now → then]].
Reported question: [[asked if/where ...]] urutan biasa; perintah: [[told me to ...]].

read.id:
Mona Lisa dilukis oleh Leonardo da Vinci pada awal abad keenam belas. Lukisan itu dipamerkan di Museum Louvre di Paris, tempat lukisan itu dilihat oleh jutaan pengunjung setiap tahun.
Lukisan itu dilindungi kaca antipeluru. Lukisan itu dicuri pada 1911, tetapi ditemukan dua tahun kemudian. Sejak itu, keamanan ditingkatkan. Banyak orang mengatakan bahwa senyumnya adalah yang paling misterius dalam sejarah seni.

qs.q: Who painted the Mona Lisa?

qs.exp: Teks: "displayed in the Louvre Museum in Paris".
qs.q: Where is the painting displayed?

qs.exp: Teks: "stolen in 1911, but found two years later."
qs.q: How long was the painting missing after it was stolen?
What protects the painting now?

read.text:
The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci in the early sixteenth century. It is displayed in the Louvre Museum in Paris, where it is seen by millions of visitors every year.
The painting is protected by bulletproof glass. It was stolen in 1911, but it was found two years later. Since then, security has been increased. Many people say that her smile is the most mysterious in art history.
read.title: The Famous Painting

Kemarin, seorang reporter mewawancarai wali kota. Reporter itu bertanya apakah kota akan membangun lebih banyak taman. Wali kota mengatakan bahwa kota berencana membangun lima taman baru pada akhir tahun.
Ketika ditanya tentang biayanya, dia menjelaskan bahwa anggaran sudah disetujui. Dia menambahkan bahwa warga dipersilakan memberikan saran. Reporter itu berterima kasih dan mengatakan bahwa dia akan menerbitkan wawancara itu keesokan harinya.

qs.exp: Teks: "asked him whether the city would build more parks."
options: Whether the city would build more parks
How old the mayor was when he started work
When the mayor would retire from the office
Who the mayor was before the election
qs.q: What did the reporter ask?
How many new parks are planned?

qs.exp: Teks: "the budget had already been approved."
qs.q: What had already been approved?

qs.exp: Teks: "would publish the interview the next day."
qs.q: When would the reporter publish the interview?

read.text:
Yesterday, a reporter interviewed the mayor. The reporter asked him whether the city would build more parks. The mayor said that the city planned to build five new parks by the end of the year.
When asked about the cost, he explained that the budget had already been approved. He added that the citizens were welcome to give their suggestions. The reporter thanked him and said that she would publish the interview the next day.
read.title: Reported Speech: A News Interview

Perpustakaan baru dibuka oleh wali kota kemarin. Dalam pidatonya, dia mengatakan bahwa gedung itu telah dirancang oleh mahasiswa lokal. Dia menambahkan bahwa perpustakaan itu akan terbuka untuk semua orang setiap hari.
Seorang reporter bertanya apakah akan dibangun lebih banyak perpustakaan. Wali kota menjawab bahwa dua lagi direncanakan untuk tahun depan. Banyak warga mengatakan mereka senang, dan beberapa dari mereka bercerita kepada reporter bahwa mereka sudah menunggu perpustakaan itu bertahun-tahun.

read.text:
The new library was opened by the mayor yesterday. In his speech, he said that the building had been designed by local students. He added that it would be open to everyone every day.
A reporter asked him whether more libraries would be built. The mayor answered that two more were planned for next year. Many residents said they were happy, and some of them told the reporter that they had been waiting for a library for years.

Kemarin, seorang jurnalis mewawancarai Bu Ratna, dokter setempat. Jurnalis itu bertanya sudah berapa lama dia bekerja di klinik. Bu Ratna berkata bahwa dia sudah bekerja di sana selama dua belas tahun.
Dia mengatakan kepada jurnalis bahwa klinik itu dibangun oleh warga desa sendiri. Ketika jurnalis bertanya apa yang ingin dilakukannya berikutnya, Bu Ratna menjawab bahwa dia akan membuka bangsal anak. Dia meminta jurnalis menulis tentang kebutuhan akan relawan.

qs.q: How long had Ms. Ratna worked at the clinic?

options: She said that she will open a children's ward.
She said that she would open a children's ward.
The journalist asked how long she had worked there.
The clinic had been built by villagers.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?

qs.exp: Teks: "had been built by the villagers themselves".
qs.q: Who built the clinic?
Pasangkan bentuk langsung dengan bentuk dalam reported speech:
Ms. Ratna said that she ___ (work) there for twelve years.
She said she ___ (will) open a children's ward.

qs.answer: The clinic had been built by the villagers.
qs.exp: Past perfect passive: had been + V3.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Klinik itu dibangun oleh warga desa."

read.text:
Yesterday, a journalist interviewed Ms. Ratna, a local doctor. The journalist asked her how long she had worked at the clinic. Ms. Ratna said that she had worked there for twelve years.
She told the journalist that the clinic had been built by the villagers themselves. When the journalist asked what she wanted to do next, Ms. Ratna answered that she would open a children's ward. She asked the journalist to write about the need for volunteers.
read.title: A Reported Interview

Ana: Bisakah ruangan dipesan untuk hari Senin? Manajer: Ruangan sudah dipesan. Proyektor boleh dipakai, tetapi harus dikembalikan sesudahnya. Ana: Dimengerti. Semuanya akan disiapkan tepat waktu.

read.text:
Manager: The report must be finished by Friday. The figures can be checked by the finance team, and the charts should be updated before the meeting. Ana: Will the draft be sent to the client? Manager: It will be sent after it has been approved.

Rina: Batik ini dibuat dengan tangan di Pekalongan. Dijual kepada turis dan diekspor ke Jepang. Batik ini terkenal karena warnanya yang cerah. Tom: Apakah dibuat dari katun? Rina: Ya, dibuat dari katun, dan dihias dengan pewarna alami.
Tom: Untuk siapa batik ini dirancang? Rina: Dirancang untuk anak muda yang peduli pada tradisi. Kemejanya dikirim ke toko-toko di Jakarta dengan truk. Tom: Menakjubkan berapa banyak orang yang terlibat dalam prosesnya.

options: The batik is known by its bright colors.
The batik is known for its bright colors.
It is decorated with natural dyes.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "The shirts are delivered ___ truck."
Pasangkan frasa dengan artinya:
It is known ___ its bright colors.
It's exported ___ Japan.

qs.answer: The batik is made by hand.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Batik itu dibuat dengan tangan."

read.text:
Rina: This batik is made by hand in Pekalongan. It's sold to tourists and exported to Japan. It is known for its bright colors. Tom: Is it made from cotton? Rina: Yes, it's made from cotton, and it's decorated with natural dyes.
Tom: Who is it designed for? Rina: It's designed for young people who care about tradition. The shirts are delivered to shops in Jakarta by truck. Tom: It's amazing how many people are involved in the process.
read.title: Made for Export
